# mimecast_dmarc_domains (Data Source)

Read the complete typed DMARC Analyzer managed-domain inventory with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC managed-domain inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `activity_status` (String) Managed-domain activity status.
- `detected_status` (String) Detected-domain activity status.
- `dkim_delegation_id` (String) DKIM delegation record ID.
- `dkim_status` (String) DKIM DNS configuration status.
- `dmarc_delegation_id` (String) DMARC delegation record ID.
- `dmarc_policy` (String) Published DMARC policy.
- `dmarc_status` (String) DMARC DNS configuration status.
- `dns_a_records` (Attributes List) A records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_a_records))
- `dns_aaaa_records` (Attributes List) AAAA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_aaaa_records))
- `dns_caa_records` (Attributes List) CAA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_caa_records))
- `dns_cname_records` (Attributes List) CNAME records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_cname_records))
- `dns_dkim_records` (Attributes List) DKIM records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_dkim_records))
- `dns_dmarc_records` (Attributes List) DMARC records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_dmarc_records))
- `dns_dnskey_records` (Attributes List) DNSKEY records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_dnskey_records))
- `dns_ds_records` (Attributes List) DS records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_ds_records))
- `dns_mx_records` (Attributes List) MX records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_mx_records))
- `dns_ns_records` (Attributes List) NS records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_ns_records))
- `dns_ptr_records` (Attributes List) PTR records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_ptr_records))
- `dns_soa_records` (Attributes List) SOA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_soa_records))
- `dns_srv_records` (Attributes List) SRV records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_srv_records))
- `dns_txt_records` (Attributes List) TXT records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--dns_txt_records))
- `domain` (String) Managed domain name.
- `id` (String) DMARC Analyzer managed-domain ID.
- `is_policy_inherited` (Boolean) Whether the DMARC policy is inherited from a parent domain.
- `spf_delegation_id` (String) SPF delegation record ID.
- `spf_status` (String) SPF DNS configuration status.
- `status` (String) Managed-domain lifecycle stage.
